doc.title: Jamey Aebersold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 26, 2022

title: Goodbyes and Volume 1 shown on camera
summary: Thanks and goodbyes, with Aebersold showing Volume 1 and Monk showing old sheet music.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thank you for this time, Mr. Aebersold, you’re a nice man.
Well you’re nice too, Monk, and thanks for having me on.
All right. I’m just going to pause here and we’ll say our good-byes.
Okay I want to show you something.
Yes please do. Volume 1 All right.
It’s Volume 1, yes. And it’s made its way to China.
The other side of the world and they have their Jamey Aebersolds.
Right. And this is how I got started with play-a-longs.
Look at that.
This one and this one. In the mid-50s.
Hold on. I have to get into the cupboard here, if I can find it.
Ah. Now I haven’t seen that one.
Yeah this goes way back. It wasn’t a play-a-long it’s just that they would publish the sheet music.
Well is that different than sheet music?
It’s just popular songs with articles and it cost ten cents.
Yeah. Ten cents. Hey well I enjoyed it.
I enjoyed it too.
All right. Thank you. You let me know when it’s up.
I will indeed.
All right. © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
